sprints.title: Sprint 0 – Foundation
sprints.goal: An empty repo where `make lint test` passes locally and in CI.

sprints.title: Sprint 1 – Platform core
sprints.goal: user-service starts, connects to Postgres, answers health checks and shuts down cleanly on SIGTERM.

sprints.title: Sprint 2 – Dev sign-in
sprints.goal: Get a token via `DevSignIn` with grpcurl and call `GetMe` with it.

sprints.title: Sprint 3 – Households
sprints.goal: Two dev users share a household via an invite code.

sprints.title: Sprint 4 – list-service
sprints.goal: Household members manage lists via grpcurl; strangers get `PermissionDenied`.

sprints.title: Sprint 5 – Items
sprints.goal: Add, check off and delete items; concurrent changes end in `Aborted` instead of silent overwrites.

sprints.title: Sprint 6 – Real-time sync
sprints.goal: Two grpcurl sessions see each other's changes live.

sprints.title: Sprint 7 – Local Kubernetes
sprints.goal: The whole system runs in k3d and is reachable through Traefik via grpcurl.

sprints.title: Sprint 8 – iOS basics
sprints.goal: The app signs in via dev login and shows households and lists from the k3d cluster.

sprints.title: Sprint 9 – Live updates in the app
sprints.goal: Two simulators edit the same list and see changes instantly.

sprints.title: Sprint 10 – Sign in with Apple
sprints.goal: Sign-in via Apple only; expired tokens refresh silently.

sprints.title: Sprint 11 – Homelab
sprints.goal: Zettel runs in the homelab K3s cluster and is reachable from outside.

sprints.title: Sprint 12 – Operations & daily use
sprints.goal: Metrics and logs are visible, and the household uses Zettel via TestFlight.

milestones.title: M1 – Backend complete locally
milestones.description: All three services run locally; two grpcurl sessions sync live.

milestones.title: M2 – Runs in k3d
milestones.description: The whole system runs in a local k3d cluster behind Traefik.

milestones.title: M3 – App MVP
milestones.description: The iOS app signs in with Apple and edits shared lists live.

milestones.title: M4 – Ready for daily use in the homelab
milestones.description: Zettel runs in the homelab with monitoring and backups; the household uses it via TestFlight.

labels.name: type:spike

tickets.title: Initialise Go module, .gitignore and LICENSE
tickets.goal: The repo is a buildable Go module.
done: `.gitignore` covers Go binaries, `.env` and Xcode user data
A LICENSE of your choice is in the root
tickets.notes: README, docs and ADRs are already in the repo.

tickets.title: Create folder layout and Makefile
tickets.goal: Every recurring command has a make target.
done: `make help` lists all targets with a short description
tickets.notes: A self-documenting `help` target can parse `## comments` after each target.

tickets.title: Set up buf and a first user.proto
tickets.goal: Protobuf code generation works with one command.
done: `buf.gen.yaml` generates Go and gRPC code into `gen/go`
tickets.notes: Use remote plugins `buf.build/protocolbuffers/go` and `buf.build/grpc/go` so you don't need local protoc plugins.

tickets.title: Configure golangci-lint
tickets.goal: Code style problems are caught automatically.
done: Linters at least: errcheck, govet, staticcheck, revive, gofmt

tickets.title: GitHub Actions: lint, buf and tests on every PR
tickets.goal: Every PR shows whether the code is healthy.
done: Workflow runs on pull requests and on pushes to `main`
A PR shows a green check
tickets.notes: Later (Z-57) this workflow gets an image build job.

tickets.title: docker-compose with Postgres for local development
tickets.goal: A local Postgres is one command away.
done: `docker-compose.yml` starts Postgres with a named volume
Credentials come from `.env` (not committed); `.env.example` is committed

tickets.title: Review and accept ADR-0001 to ADR-0006
tickets.goal: The architecture decisions are your own.
done: Each ADR in `docs/adr/` is read and adjusted where you decide differently
Status changed from Proposed to Accepted

tickets.title: platform/config: load env vars into a struct
tickets.goal: Services read configuration from the environment in one place.
done: `config.Load[T]()` (or similar) fills a struct from `ZETTEL_*` env vars
A missing required value stops startup with a clear error naming the variable
Unit test for missing and present values

tickets.title: platform/logging: slog JSON logger and logging interceptor
tickets.goal: Every gRPC call leaves one structured log line.
done: Logger writes JSON to stdout, level from config
Unary interceptor logs method, status code and duration
Errors are logged at error level

tickets.title: platform/grpcserver: start, health, reflection, graceful shutdown
tickets.goal: All services start the same way.
done: Server listens on a configurable port
gRPC health service and reflection are registered
SIGTERM stops accepting new calls and lets running calls finish

tickets.title: platform/postgres: pgx pool and goose migrations on startup
tickets.goal: A service connects to Postgres and migrates its schema on start.
done: Connection pool from a DSN in config
Migrations embedded with `go:embed` and applied with goose on startup
Startup fails clearly if the database is unreachable

tickets.title: Wire up cmd/user-service/main.go
tickets.goal: user-service runs locally against Postgres.
done: `main.go` loads config, logger, DB, gRPC server
Service runs against the docker-compose Postgres

tickets.title: user.proto: User, TokenPair, DevSignIn, GetMe
tickets.goal: The first real API contract exists.

tickets.title: users table migration and repository with testcontainers tests
tickets.goal: Users are stored and read back reliably.
done: Tests run against a real Postgres via testcontainers-go

tickets.title: platform/auth: issue and verify Ed25519 JWTs, unary interceptor
tickets.goal: Calls are authenticated with self-issued JWTs.
done: Issue access tokens with `sub` = user ID, `exp` = 15 min
Verify with the public key only
Unary interceptor puts the user ID into the context
Allow-list for methods without auth (sign-in RPCs, health)

tickets.title: Implement DevSignIn and GetMe
tickets.goal: You can get a token and call an authenticated RPC with grpcurl.
done: `DevSignIn` creates a user for a display name and returns tokens
Demo: grpcurl sign-in, then `GetMe` with the token

tickets.title: Handler tests with bufconn
tickets.goal: Handlers are tested end to end without a network.
done: Test server via `bufconn` with the real interceptor chain
Test covers sign-in and `GetMe`, with and without token

tickets.title: Extend user.proto with household RPCs and MembershipService
tickets.goal: The household API contract is defined.

tickets.title: Migrations for households, household_members, invites
tickets.goal: The household tables exist.
done: Tables as in the data model
Migration runs up and down cleanly

tickets.title: CreateHousehold and ListMyHouseholds
tickets.goal: A user can create households and list their own.
done: Creator is stored as `owner` in one transaction with the household

tickets.title: CreateInvite and AcceptInvite
tickets.goal: A second user joins a household with a code.
done: Code: 8 characters, no ambiguous characters, valid 48 h

tickets.title: ListMembers and LeaveHousehold
tickets.goal: Members can see each other and leave.

tickets.title: CheckMembership (internal)
tickets.goal: Other services can ask whether a user belongs to a household.
done: Correct answer for member and non-member
Not exposed through the ingress later (see ADR-0002)

tickets.title: Complete list.proto
tickets.goal: The list API contract is defined.
done: All RPCs from the plan with `expected_version` where needed

tickets.title: cmd/list-service and migrations for lists and items
tickets.goal: list-service starts with its own schema.
done: Own DB role with rights only on `list_svc`

tickets.title: gRPC client to user-service, authorization via CheckMembership
tickets.goal: Only household members can touch a household's lists.
tickets.notes: Hide the client behind an interface so the service can be tested with a fake.

tickets.title: CreateList, ListLists, RenameList, ArchiveList
tickets.goal: Household members manage lists.
done: Archived lists no longer appear in `ListLists`

tickets.title: AddItem, ListItems, DeleteItem (soft delete)
tickets.goal: Items can be added, listed and removed.
done: Deleted items set `deleted_at` and no longer appear

tickets.title: UpdateItem and SetItemChecked with expected_version
tickets.goal: Concurrent changes never overwrite each other silently.

tickets.title: Repository tests for version conflicts
tickets.goal: Optimistic locking is proven by tests.
done: Two parallel updates with the same version: exactly one succeeds

tickets.title: sync.proto: Event, Subscribe, Publish
tickets.goal: The sync API contract is defined.
done: `Event` with `oneof` payload as in the plan

tickets.title: Hub: per-household subscriptions with channels, clean unsubscribe
tickets.goal: Events fan out to every subscriber of a household.
done: Subscribe returns a channel; unsubscribe closes it
Subscription ends when the client disconnects
No goroutine leaks (check with a test)
tickets.notes: Protect the map with a mutex; keep the design simple.

tickets.title: Subscribe with stream interceptor and membership check
tickets.goal: Only members receive a household's events.
done: Stream sends events until the client disconnects

tickets.title: Publish (internal); list-service sends an event after every change
tickets.goal: Every list or item change reaches the hub.
done: list-service publishes after each successful write
A failed publish is logged and does not fail the write
Demo: `AddItem` shows up in an open stream

tickets.title: Keepalive and slow clients
tickets.goal: A stuck client cannot block the hub.
done: A full subscriber buffer closes that stream

tickets.title: Hub tests with go test -race
tickets.goal: The hub is free of data races.

tickets.title: Multi-stage Dockerfile, one image per service
tickets.goal: Each service ships as a small container image.
done: One Dockerfile with a build arg for the service
Images under 30 MB and start locally

tickets.title: k3d cluster config with registry, make cluster-up
tickets.goal: A local cluster is one command away.

tickets.title: Postgres StatefulSet, schemas and roles per service
tickets.goal: Postgres runs in the cluster with one schema per service.
done: Init script creates schemas and roles

tickets.title: Kustomize base: Deployments, Services, ConfigMaps, Secrets, gRPC probes
tickets.goal: All services run in k3d.
done: Native gRPC readiness and liveness probes

tickets.title: Traefik IngressRoute with h2c and path routing
tickets.goal: The cluster is reachable from your machine via gRPC.
done: Routes by gRPC path prefix to each public service
Sign-in, lists and stream work via `localhost:8080`
Internal RPCs are not reachable from outside

done: `make gen` updates Go and Swift code

tickets.title: API client with auth header, token in Keychain

done: One client type wraps all services

tickets.title: Screens: dev sign-in, create and join household
tickets.goal: A user can get into a household from the app.
done: Dev sign-in screen with display name

tickets.title: Screen: lists of a household

tickets.title: List detail: show, add, check off, swipe to delete

done: All actions go to the backend

tickets.title: Subscribe stream in the app, UI reacts to events

tickets.title: Reconnect: reload after a drop, then resubscribe

done: Stream end triggers a reload and a new subscription with backoff
Airplane mode on and off: the list is correct afterwards
tickets.notes: See ADR-0003: events during the outage are lost, the reload fixes that.

tickets.title: Handle Aborted: reload and show a short hint
tickets.goal: Conflicts never destroy user input.
